deadline_timesteps_entity.description: Number of 15-minute steps from now by which the load must be done; 0 = no deadline.
deadline_timesteps_entity.title: Deadline (time steps from now) from

single_constant_entity.title: Run in one block when on

base_url.description: Base URL of the EMHASS App, e.g. http://5b918bf2-emhass:5000. Leave empty to look it up through the Supervisor.
base_url.title: EMHASS address

extra_runtime_params.description: Added to every MPC payload as-is (shown in each run's Explain view).
extra_runtime_params.title: Extra runtime parameters

mode.description: Off: never calls EMHASS actions. Dry run: builds and checks every payload but does not send it. Live: runs and publishes.
mode.title: Mode

num_lags.description: Leave empty to derive it like before: 192 + 96 × forecast extension days.
num_lags.title: Lags

var_model.description: The household power sensor (without deferrable loads) EMHASS learns from.
var_model.title: Load sensor for the ML model

auto.description: Run naive-mpc-optim every quarter-hour. Only acts when the mode is dry run or live.
auto.title: Run MPC automatically

hazard_guard_s.description: Older EMHASS versions (< 0.18.2) can fail when a run starts within this many seconds of a slot rounding boundary; the run waits it out.
hazard_guard_s.title: Grid-boundary guard

max_horizon.description: Cap the number of slots sent to EMHASS.
max_horizon.title: Maximum horizon

min_horizon.description: Refuse to run when fewer future slots than this have prices.
min_horizon.title: Minimum horizon

slot_offset_s.description: 780 = mm:13:00, two minutes before the next quarter starts, so the plan for the next slot is ready before it is published.
slot_offset_s.title: Run at (seconds into each quarter)

enabled.description: Call publish-data right after each quarter starts (live mode), so EMHASS's sensor.p_* entities show the slot that just began.
enabled.title: Publish each quarter

on_unavailable.description: Refuse: skip the run and raise a problem. Default: use the value below.
on_unavailable.title: When unavailable

scale.description: 0.01 turns a percentage into the 0–1 EMHASS expects.
scale.title: Multiply by

vat_included_pct.description: Removed before Estonian tariffs are applied. 0 if the values exclude VAT.
vat_included_pct.title: VAT included in the values

source.description: Extends the price horizon beyond the published day-ahead prices.
source.title: Price forecast

tomorrow_error_after.title: Error if tomorrow's prices are missing after

tomorrow_warn_after.title: Warn if tomorrow's prices are missing after

soc_final.title: Battery state of charge at the end of the horizon

component_levels.description: e.g. {"emhass": "debug"} for more detail from one part only.
component_levels.title: Per-component levels

level.description: Default follows the log_level option in the App's Configuration tab.
level.title: Log level

day_peak.description: Working days 09–12 and 16–20, November–March. Empty = no peak rate.
day_peak.title: Day peak

holiday_peak.description: Weekends and holidays 16–20, November–March. Empty = no peak rate.
holiday_peak.title: Weekend peak

clock_basis.description: Local: the window follows the wall clock. Standard time: it is defined in winter time, so in summer it shifts one hour later (e.g. 23–08).
clock_basis.title: Clock

publish_time.description: Local time from which tomorrow's prices are polled.
publish_time.title: Day-ahead results expected at

persistent.description: Raise a persistent notification for problems that last longer than the grace time.
persistent.title: Home Assistant notifications

fire_event.description: emhass_lens_plan_published, with the current slot's plan values in the event data.
fire_event.title: Fire an event after each publish

mqtt_enabled.description: Publish the EMHASS Lens device (prices, problem, last MPC, Auto MPC switch, Run MPC button) through MQTT discovery. Needs the Mosquitto broker App.
mqtt_enabled.title: MQTT entities

enabled.description: While the old integration still runs, compare its prices and MPC payload with ours.
enabled.title: Compare with the HACS integration

package.description: Elektrilevi Võrk 1/2/4/5 bring their own network rates; Custom uses the rates below.
package.title: Network package
